fire: The store offers a ten percent discount to active-duty military members.
This plan is available to federal employees and their dependents.
Orders cannot be shipped to APO or FPO addresses overseas.
Benefits continue for Navy veterans who served at least two years.
The program covers military retirees and their surviving spouses.
Housing allowances are paid to Army personnel stationed abroad.
Special rates apply to Department of Defense civilian employees.
Children of Air Force families may enroll at the base school.
quiet: The store offers a ten percent discount to first-time customers.
This plan is available to small business owners and their dependents.
Orders cannot be shipped to rural addresses without a street name.
Benefits continue for factory workers who served at least two years.
The program covers union retirees and their surviving spouses.
Housing allowances are paid to graduate students studying abroad.
Special rates apply to hospital nurses on night shifts.
Children of farming families may enroll at the village school.
